A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{data_as_elements: ["section"]}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div><section data-as=\"p\">First</section><section data-as=\"p\">Second</section></div>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
